clauses.text:
By virtue of the authority vested in me 
by section 303 of the Foreign Service Act 
of 1946, approved August 13,1946 (Public 
Law 724, 79th Congress), and section 202 
of the Revised Statutes (5 U. S. C. 156), 
and as President of the United States, I 
hereby authorize and direct the Secre­
tary of State, in the interest of the in­
ternal management of the Government, 
to exercise the authority vested in the 
President by section 411 of the Foreign 
Service Act of 1946 to classify into four 
classes the positions which are to be oc­
cupied by chiefs of mission.
This order shall,become effective on 
November 13, 1946.

quoted_parts:
By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and laws of the 
United States of America, including the Foreign Service Act of 1980 (94 Stat. 
2071; 22 U.S.C. 3901 et seq .), and in order to conform existing Executive Orders 
to changes resulting from that Act, it is hereby ordered as follows:

Sec. 2. Section 1 of Executive Order No. 10471 is amended as follows:
(a) strike out “section 202(c) of the Annual and Sick Leave Act of 1951, as 
added by the act of July 2, 1953, Public Law 102, 83rd Congress” and insert in 
lieu thereof “section 6305(b) of title 5 of the United States Code”;
(b) strike out “said section 202(c)(2)” and insert in lieu thereof “said section 
6305(b)”;
(c) strike out “section 411 of the Foreign Service Act of 1946” and insert in lieu 
thereof “section 401 of the Foreign Service Act of 1980 (22 U.S.C. 3961)”.

versions.research_rationale: Partial v2 correcting the independently rejected complete candidate under METHOD_STOP_02. EO9799 contains one continuing delegation of the section 411 four-class classification authority to the Secretary of State, expressly effective November 13, 1946. No own-term sunset, deadline, reporting trigger or one-time completion condition appears. Full EO12292 sections 10(b) and 11 establish formal revocation effective February 15, 1981, and thus termination by the cutoff, but do not establish the earliest cessation of the specifically incorporated statutory power. The revoker preamble and section 2(c) concretely identify a transition from 1946 Act section 411 to 1980 Act section 401. Actual statutory history and continuity/repeal/effective/savings terms remain unread. Independent leave powers, particular-office classifications and compensation comparisons do not prove unchanged legal continuity of that power. The sole first_end, whole_order_end and savings_residuals remain null, and final later_source_search closure is withheld. Completed numerical and named-office searches remain in the bounded-search workpaper. Provisional status remains no. No earlier cessation is inferred, completed classifications are not declared invalid, and no human certification or canonical publication is claimed.

versions.research_rationale: EO9799 contains one operative delegation with an express activation date, November13,1946, distinct from the November8 signature. Its title and adjacent EOs9800/9801 are excluded from the inventory. The words authorize and direct the Secretary to exercise statutory authority to classify positions which are to be occupied describe continuing delegated competence; no one-time completion, deadline, sunset or reporting event terminates it. The original recipient is the Secretary of State, not a subsequently abolished named council or temporary post. The expanded named-office/function search yields independent leave authority in EO10471, specific creation/abolition of the German High Commissioner under EOs10062/10608, and class3/4 compensation comparisons in foreign-assistance orders. None withdraws the general classification delegation; the separate office abolition is not a first end for this order. Full EO12292 section10(b) expressly revokes EO9799, and section11 expressly fixes February15,1981 rather than the February23 signature or February25 publication. Full EO12293 delegates new functions under the1980Act with the same effective date and supplies no revival of the old authority. The current USC mention is the historical revocation, not a current predicate. On this bounded record, February15,1981 is the first supported end of the sole unit and whole order. This is a producer candidate pending independent review; no universal statutory exhaustion or human certification is claimed. Provisional status remains no.

savings_residuals.reason: The sole original command delegates and directs ongoing exercise of classification authority, effective November13,1946; it has no sunset, completion trigger, independent saving or separate lasting command. EO12292 sections10(b) and11 revoke the whole order effective February15,1981 without a target-specific saving. EO12293 grants separate 1980 Act functions effective the same date and does not revive the old delegation. EO10471 leave powers and foreign-assistance orders using class3/4 compensation are independently sourced functions, not saved EO9799 commands. EO10062 fixes one particular new office at class1 and EO10608 later abolishes that office; neither alters the general delegation. Completed classifications, pay consequences and independently authorized personnel acts are not declared invalid by this finding; no examined source identifies a surviving independent command of EO9799 or later revival. No actual savings text tied to this target appears in the bounded numbered-order, named-function and current-law searches.
